records.source: The phenotype channel to find pathogens in, by its name in ops_ph_channels, as pathogen_channel is in Mask Generation. Set, each field's pathogens are segmented with Cellpose and every cell gains cell_pathogen_ columns: how many pathogens it holds, their area and share of the cell, their shape, and their mean intensity in each channel. They reach the gene profiles and clusters like the cell's own features. Empty finds none. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Fenotypkanalen där patogener söks, med sitt namn i ops_ph_channels, som pathogen_channel i Mask Generation. Satt segmenteras varje fälts patogener med Cellpose och varje cell får cell_pathogen_-kolumner: hur många patogener den rymmer, deras area och andel av cellen, deras form och deras medelintensitet i varje kanal. De når genprofilerna och klustren som cellens egna egenskaper. Tomt söker inga. Standard None. Alfa.

records.source: The Cellpose model that segments the pathogens: 'cpsam', a model from the model zoo or a model file, as pathogen_model is in Mask Generation. Default 'cpsam'. Alpha.
records.translation: Cellpose-modellen som segmenterar patogenerna: 'cpsam', en modell från model zoo eller en modellfil, som pathogen_model i Mask Generation. Standard 'cpsam'. Alfa.

records.source: Expected pathogen diameter in full-resolution phenotype pixels; empty lets the model decide. Pathogens are segmented at full resolution. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Förväntad patogendiameter i fenotyppixlar med full upplösning; tomt låter modellen avgöra. Patogener segmenteras med full upplösning. Standard None. Alfa.

records.source: Pathogens smaller than this many pixels are dropped; 0 keeps all. Default 0. Alpha.
records.translation: Patogener som är mindre än så här många pixlar tas bort; 0 behåller alla. Standard 0. Alfa.

records.source: The phenotype channel to find organelles in, by its name in ops_ph_channels, as organelle_channel is in Mask Generation. Set, each field's organelles are segmented and every cell gains cell_organelle_ columns: how many it holds, their area and share of the cell, their shape, and their mean intensity in each channel. They reach the gene profiles and clusters. Empty finds none. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Fenotypkanalen där organeller söks, med sitt namn i ops_ph_channels, som organelle_channel i Mask Generation. Satt segmenteras varje fälts organeller och varje cell får cell_organelle_-kolumner: hur många den rymmer, deras area och andel av cellen, deras form och deras medelintensitet i varje kanal. De når genprofilerna och klustren. Tomt söker inga. Standard None. Alfa.

records.source: What the organelles look like, as in Mask Generation: 'spots' (vesicles, droplets), 'network' (mitochondria, ER), 'irregular' (Golgi, lysosomes) or 'ring' (endosomes). Default 'spots'. Alpha.
records.translation: Hur organellerna ser ut, som i Mask Generation: 'spots' (vesiklar, droppar), 'network' (mitokondrier, ER), 'irregular' (Golgi, lysosomer) eller 'ring' (endosomer). Standard 'spots'. Alfa.

records.source: How the organelles are found, as in Mask Generation: 'otsu' or 'adaptive' thresholds for every morphology, 'log' and 'dog' for spots and rings, 'ridge' and 'hysteresis' for networks, or 'cellpose' with ops_ph_organelle_model. Default 'otsu'. Alpha.
records.translation: Hur organellerna hittas, som i Mask Generation: tröskelvärdena 'otsu' eller 'adaptive' för varje morfologi, 'log' och 'dog' för prickar och ringar, 'ridge' och 'hysteresis' för nätverk, eller 'cellpose' med ops_ph_organelle_model. Standard 'otsu'. Alfa.

records.source: The Cellpose model for the 'cellpose' organelle method: 'cpsam', a model from the model zoo or a model file. Default 'cpsam'. Alpha.
records.translation: Cellpose-modellen för organellmetoden 'cellpose': 'cpsam', en modell från model zoo eller en modellfil. Standard 'cpsam'. Alfa.

records.source: Expected organelle diameter in full-resolution phenotype pixels for the 'cellpose' method; empty lets the model decide. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Förväntad organelldiameter i fenotyppixlar med full upplösning för metoden 'cellpose'; tomt låter modellen avgöra. Standard None. Alfa.

records.source: Organelles smaller than this many pixels are dropped. Default 10, as in Mask Generation. Alpha.
records.translation: Organeller som är mindre än så här många pixlar tas bort. Standard 10, som i Mask Generation. Alfa.
